Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns you if it hits, so dodge with minions or jungle monsters between you. While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, don’t group with allies, and keep your distance before Amumu closes in. Amumu W Despair deals damage the longer you stay nearby, so keep adjusting your distance even after engaging.
Amumu.fight: Amumu E Tantrum becomes easier to recast the more basic attacks he takes, so don’t fight near Amumu for long.
Amumu.laning: Engage when your lane is pushed in and the enemy is within range of both abilities. Amumu Q Bandage Toss is blocked by minions, so when you face him in lane, stand behind minions and move unpredictably.
Amumu.escape: Engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are on cooldown.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from allies and take fights in open terrain.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Amumu’s magic damage. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stack too much health. Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so build armor penetration or attack alongside your allies’ magic damage.

Brand.watch: If Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration hits you and sets you ablaze, his next ability can follow up and stack Brand P Blaze. While ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear’s projectile or stand behind minions to avoid the stun. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from allies to prevent its bounces from damaging you.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Brand’s damage. Brand P Blaze scales with your max health, so be cautious about building a lot of health alone, and get movement speed to leave the warned attack areas.
Brand.laning: Stand away from minions Brand has set ablaze to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading to you.
Brand.escape: Engage right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used. If you’re already ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in; if you aren’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you. Brand has no mobility ability, so once you close the distance, he has no way to escape.
Brand.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing, and don’t stand beside allies who are ablaze.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor, so watch your distance to avoid it. If an ally is targeted by Briar R Certain Death, group up and fight back together.
Briar.build: Build armor first to prepare for Briar’s main damage. It’s also important to dodge Briar Q Head Rush, which reduces resistances. If healing makes the duel drag on, buy Executioner’s Calling after one core item.
Briar.fight: During Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she chases the nearest enemy, so block her path from the front to protect your allied damage dealers.
Briar.laning: Warn allies not to stay in the middle of the lane for long without vision. If Briar engages recklessly, meet her from the front and use it as an opportunity to counterattack.
Briar.combo: Apply P Martial Cadence with a basic attack right after landing, trap the target with R Cataclysm, then add a shield and slow with W Golden Aegis. If Briar E Chilling Scream is charging, time your knock-up to interrupt it.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is on cooldown.
Briar.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies with R Cataclysm rather than dealing damage.
Briar.teamfight: When Briar comes in with W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, stand on the frontline and catch her before she reaches your allied damage dealers.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and leaves a mark. Dodge sideways instead of retreating in a straight line, and if it hits, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush may reset. Don’t approach right after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; wait until the orbs and shield disappear.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Diana’s damage. Consider movement speed to help you leave the warned attack areas.
Diana.fight: Engage after dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike and when Diana E Lunar Rush is on cooldown.
Diana.laning: Approach when your lane is pushed in and Diana is within dash range.
Diana.escape: If you’re hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, Diana E Lunar Rush may be recast, so don’t engage; create distance instead.
Diana.phase: In the late game, contribute by engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to block Diana’s flank approach and spread out so multiple allies aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall.

Ekko.watch: When you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s tell, move out of its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see an afterimage behind Ekko, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.
Ekko.build: Complete one core item first, then fit in Executioner's Calling if Ekko’s healing becomes a problem. Build magic resistance rather than armor against his magic damage.
Ekko.fight: If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, account for it before deciding to engage.
Ekko.laning: Before engaging, check whether Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown. If you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s tell, avoid that spot when choosing your approach.
Ekko.combo: Use Jarvan IV E Demacian Standard, then immediately cast Q Dragon Strike toward the flag to knock Ekko up. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, check his afterimage’s location and whether your allies can follow before trapping him.
Ekko.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping rather than damage.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Also consider armor because she deals basic attack damage, and if healing from Elise P Spider Queen becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Elise.laning: Secure vision to avoid giving up kills to Elise’s early ganks, and don’t push the lane recklessly when she’s missing.
Elise.escape: If Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are both on cooldown, counter-engage with EQ. Watch where she can land, since E Rappel can use nearby units for its landing.
Elise.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping rather than damage.
Elise.teamfight: If an ally is engaged on first, use R Cataclysm to block the enemy engager’s path. If an allied damage dealer is trapped by the wall, recast it to bring it down immediately.

Evelynn.watch: If you see an Evelynn W Allure mark, she’s nearby preparing a charm, so back away before the mark matures and alert your allies.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike, Evelynn W Allure, and Evelynn E Whiplash. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize backing away before the mark matures over stacking health. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance while Evelynn W Allure’s mark matures, and look for an engage before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up.
Evelynn.laning: Carry a Control Ward, and also place vision beside the jungle camp where Evelynn will start a fight.
Evelynn.combo: Evelynn can escape if Evelynn R Last Caress is still available, so check whether she has used it.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is on cooldown; look for an opening after she has also used Evelynn R Last Caress.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping rather than damage, and be ready for Evelynn to dive your backline.

Gragas.watch: If you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius. If you’re near the barrel and also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam, you can be hit by both abilities, so don’t counterattack from that spot. While Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or enemy territory.
Gragas.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Gragas’s damage, and avoid stacking only health because Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on maximum health. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after buying one core item.
Gragas.laning: Before engaging, check whether Gragas E Body Slam is on cooldown.
Gragas.phase: Gragas is strong at burst damage and disrupting formations in the early and mid game, so hold your formation and endure during objective fights.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your backline alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch out for narrow chokepoints and bushes where you have no vision.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam provides both mobility and a knock-up, so right after he uses it is your opening to engage. Gragas can use E Body Slam again, so only chase deep when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: While Gragas drinks with W Drunken Rage, hold your burst damage until the damage reduction ends.

Fiddlesticks.watch: If you couldn’t interrupt it, move out of range and let the duration run out. If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, suspect a brush ambush, and don’t enter narrow paths without vision as a group.
Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest’s healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Fiddlesticks’ damage.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Engage when your allied wave is pushed in and Fiddlesticks is within combo range. Keep the brush behind the lane warded, and don’t pass close to a stationary Scarecrow Effigy until you’ve checked it.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Immediately after landing, use a basic attack to deal P Martial Cadence’s bonus damage, then trap Fiddlesticks with R Cataclysm and add a shield and slow with W Golden Aegis. If you need to interrupt the channel of Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest or R Crowstorm, use E and Q at that moment.
Fiddlesticks.escape: The window to engage is while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is on cooldown.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the brushes and approaches near objectives, and spread out so you aren’t hit together by Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, your vision is blocked and you’re slowed; leave by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so fight with minions or allies between you.
Graves.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first because Graves’ main damage from P New Destiny, Q End of the Line, and R Collateral Damage is physical. Armor does not block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Fight in open terrain so you can avoid the immediate explosion from Graves Q End of the Line.
Graves.laning: If your allied wave is pushed toward the enemy turret, your engage angle is narrow, so go in after the wave pushes toward you. Before engaging, check whether Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown.
Graves.combo: Graves can escape if his mobility ability is available, so check whether he has used it before engaging.
Graves.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, first leave its area and regain vision, then re-engage.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run. If Hecarim turns away and creates distance, move toward your allies and avoid his engage path.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first because Hecarim’s main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge is physical. If Hecarim W Spirit of Dread’s healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Hecarim.escape: When only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is on cooldown, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so check for his other mobility ability before engaging.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear multiple people.

Ivern.watch: If you’re hit by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash to your rooted position, so stand behind minions or terrain before he casts it. Engaging a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed right away will be stopped by its shield and the slow that follows, so engage after it explodes. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away to avoid being knocked up by repeated attacks.
Ivern.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ivern’s damage. However, it’s often more dangerous when allies follow up on the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! than Ivern’s own damage, so prioritize tenacity in many cases. Movement speed is also useful for escaping telegraphed areas.
Ivern.fight: Close the distance right after Ivern Q Rootcaller is on cooldown.
Ivern.laning: Be alert for an ambush when passing beside brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.escape: The window to engage is right after Ivern Q Rootcaller, his only means of mobility, is on cooldown.
Ivern.phase: In the late game, help your team fight by engaging and trapping enemies rather than focusing on damage.
Ivern.teamfight: Rather than chasing Ivern deep, look for a chance to pick off the ally protected by Ivern E Triggerseed after it explodes.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the line-shaped hitbox of Kayn W Blade's Reach. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about extended fights in close range.
Kayn.build: Build armor first to counter the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Darkin Slayer's healing makes the duel drag on, slot Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn's jungle routes and objectives while he's weak before transforming.
Kayn.laning: Before engaging, check whether Kayn has used his mobility ability. If you see the warning that Kayn is inside terrain, stop trading and retreat toward a turret.
Kayn.escape: Don't engage hastily after Kayn uses only Q Reaping Slash; he can still escape with R Umbral Trespass.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, your basic attacks are negated, and its recast can stun you. Stop basic attacking and move out of range.
Jax.build: Consider an attack speed-reducing item first to limit Jax's main source of damage: basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Don't basic attack while Jax E Counter Strike is active; move out of its stun range.
Jax.escape: Engage only after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike has ended, so you avoid the period when your basic attacks are negated.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates E Counter Strike and jumps in, don't bunch up around him. Wait for the area stun to end, then focus your crowd control.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force an engage. Look to gank when your ally’s lane is pushed in and Jax Q Leap Strike is down.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you're isolated, so stay near allied champions or minions.
Khazix.build: Build armor first to counter Kha'Zix's main damage. If the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike becomes a problem, slot Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Khazix.fight: Your chance to counterattack comes right after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage.
Khazix.laning: Before engaging, check whether Kha'Zix E Leap is down, and avoid being separated from allies and taking isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Khazix.escape: Engage right after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage. After Kha'Zix evolves E Leap, if an ally gets picked off first, consider that he may re-engage and don't rush your counterattack.
Khazix.phase: From mid game, when Kha'Zix is accumulating two or more evolutions, avoid acting alone so he can't isolate you.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in narrow areas where you have vision, and have your backline damage dealers stay near the tanks. When using R Cataclysm, check your landing position so you don't trap allied damage dealers too.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so watch for its warning and walk out of the blast. If possible, stand overlapping with minions or allies. Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and reduces your magic resistance when you pass through it, so go around the wall. Even after Karthus is killed, he can use Q Lay Waste and E Defile during his passive Death Defied, so move away from his corpse immediately. After a fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave the area of Karthus E Defile. Build magic resistance to counter Karthus's damage.
Karthus.fight: Don't engage along a path covered by Karthus W Wall of Pain, and minimize the time you spend inside Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.laning: Engage when your ally's lane is pushed in and you can keep Karthus within EQ range. Walk out of the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste as you approach.
Karthus.combo: After killing Karthus, move away from his corpse immediately to avoid his attacks during passive Death Defied.
Karthus.teamfight: Karthus can still cast abilities after he dies, so don't fight near his corpse right after killing him; reposition. Coordinate engage timing with your allies so the frontline can be cleared before an entry into the range of Karthus E Defile.

Kindred.watch: When Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, stop taking repeated hits and create distance or break line of sight. The more health has been lost, the more dangerous the follow-up damage becomes. Kindred can repeatedly create distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t chase Kindred in the zone for long.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite is a problem, slot Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Kindred.laning: Before engaging, check whether Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy are on cooldown. Clear jungle camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision nearby to delay Kindred’s mark collection.
Kindred.combo: When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone to survive and account for its healing when the zone ends as you fight.
Kindred.escape: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is on cooldown, Kindred can escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t engage hastily.
Kindred.teamfight: When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone and survive with your allies.

Lillia.watch: If you’re hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, you become a target for sleep from Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even if you have plenty of health. If you’re affected by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe spot during the drowsy period before you fall asleep. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin its cast, move sideways to avoid the center hit.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia’s primary damage. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If the healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Lillia.fight: Engage when Lillia misses her abilities and can’t build movement speed stacks.
Lillia.laning: Before engaging, check whether Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is on cooldown. If you don’t know where Lillia is, don’t pass through narrow jungle entrances or river paths where it’s hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you make Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is an opportunity to close the distance. If you’ve been hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed and are now eligible for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe spot during the drowsy period before you fall asleep instead of engaging.
Lillia.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage. Don’t force a chase while Lillia has movement speed stacks from hitting her abilities.

LeeSin.watch: In team fights, spread out so you and your allies aren’t hit together by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.build: Build armor items first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest/Cripple. After that, consider attack speed reduction to counter Lee Sin’s basic attacks and attack speed.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, retreat instead of taking the duel.
LeeSin.escape: Look to engage before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes off cooldown, but also check whether Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is on cooldown.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so don’t fight him head-on in the jungle.
LeeSin.laning: Engage when your ally’s lane is pushed in and Lee Sin or your gank target is within dash range. When you need to dodge Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike, use a minion or jungle monster to block the straight-line angle.

MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, he can’t be targeted, so aim for right after he lands. Also watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.
MasterYi.build: Withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style with health, and consider ways to reduce his attack speed. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, slot Executioner's Calling after one core item.
MasterYi.laning: Engage when your allied lane is pushed in and the opponent is within your combo range, and check whether Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is on cooldown. Gain an advantage through ganks and objective pressure while Master Yi is weak in the early game at jungling and ganking.
MasterYi.teamfight: Have your team save one crowd control ability to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, and don’t leave an ally alone to give Master Yi a takedown.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away you are when it hits, so when Nidalee steps out to throw it, dodge with a minion or an allied frontline between you. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack around the river and jungle entrances.
Nidalee.build: Complete one core item first. If the healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance against Nidalee's damage, but prioritize dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss flying in from a distance.
Nidalee.fight: Close the gap after dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack.
Nidalee.laning: Before engaging, check whether Nidalee W Pounce is on cooldown. Clear Nidalee W Bushwhack around the river and jungle entrances in advance with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability.
Nidalee.escape: Right after Nidalee W Pounce has been used is your chance to close the gap.
Nidalee.teamfight: In objective fights, place your flag ahead of time to increase your allies' attack speed, and coordinate the engage signal with them.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so dodge it by staying out of range. After it hits, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, making trades unfavorable.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your max health, so don't rely on stacking health alone. If Wukong's healing becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after one core item.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin builds armor and healing the longer you fight, so trade briefly and disengage.
MonkeyKing.laning: Before engaging, check whether Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are on cooldown.
MonkeyKing.combo: Don't use your combo on the spot where his clone appears.
MonkeyKing.escape: After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, engage in the window when he has also used Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If only Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, he can still escape with his remaining mobility, so don't rush in.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from your allies, then look for a fight or an objective fight immediately after he uses it.
MonkeyKing.phase: Gain an advantage with short trades and objective pressure during your strong period up through the mid game, as you build your items.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about relying on stacking health alone.
Poppy.fight: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is on cooldown, you have a chance to close the gap and fight.
Poppy.laning: Take Poppy E Heroic Charge in open space, with no wall or narrow passage behind you. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her shield. Before engaging, check that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended.
Poppy.escape: Don't dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active; wait for its duration to end.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping enemies rather than damage. The available information isn't enough to determine when Poppy is stronger.
Poppy.watch: Don’t stand with your back to a wall, as Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into one. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second hit lands. If Poppy charges R Keeper’s Verdict, dodge sideways from in front of her.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you airborne. When you see it, move aside toward the direction the snowball is coming from instead of running backward, and retreat to the spot where Nunu & Willump just was. If you're hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, disengage immediately before the delayed root lands.
Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first and get tenacity against the damage from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, W Biggest Snowball Ever!, and E Snowball Barrage. If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume makes it hard to finish them off, fit in Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Nunu.laning: Keep in mind that Nunu & Willump can come right back after ganking once.
Nunu.combo: Plant Jarvan IV E Demacian Standard, then immediately use Q Dragon Strike toward the flag to knock Nunu & Willump up.
Nunu.escape: Engage after dodging the airborne effect from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! or moving out of the root area of Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies rather than damage.

RekSai.watch: Watch for the knock-up when Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow pops her out of the ground. Immediately after being hit by Rek'Sai's ranged poke, stay close to allies because Rek'Sai R Void Rush can follow up.
RekSai.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
RekSai.fight: When Rek'Sai tries to burrow again to heal, keep dealing damage instead of giving her room to retreat.
RekSai.laning: Don't push the lane too hard early, and don't walk alone through areas without vision. Walk over visible tunnel entrances from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to destroy them.
RekSai.escape: Look to engage after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up and Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel's movement are down. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so check whether that ability has yet to become available again.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai tries to build an advantage through ganks, so don't give up kills and avoid traveling alone through areas without vision. In the late game, contribute to teamfights by engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball rolling toward you, put minions between you in advance to make him collide with them. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use, so stay out of range and time your mobility ability to use just after the taunt ends. Give Rammus R Soaring Slam a wide berth when he rolls in quickly, and move away from the landing spot immediately.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl greatly increases his resistances, percentage penetration is more effective than flat penetration.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop auto-attacking and switch to another target or wait for its duration to end. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is still available, find an opening to engage from outside its range.
Rammus.laning: Keep your target within range of both abilities, and use the spot where Rammus Q Powerball collides with a minion and stops as he approaches.
Rammus.phase: In the late game, contribute with engages and trapping enemies rather than damage, and don't auto-attack Rammus while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.
Rammus.teamfight: When you see Rammus engage with Q Powerball, reposition to avoid Rammus R Soaring Slam with a wide margin.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and prepare an empowered ability, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. Empowered Rengar E Bola Strike roots, so dodge it before using your mobility ability. When Rengar closes in with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, don't stay alone while injured; move with allies.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after buying one core item.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar has just been used.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to secure vision in the brush. When ganking, approach once your ally's lane is pushed in and the opponent is within EQ range. Check that you've dodged Rengar E Bola Strike before engaging.
Rengar.escape: Dodging Rengar E Bola Strike and waiting for Rengar W Battle Roar to be used create an opening to engage.
Rengar.phase: In the late game, contribute by engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage. The available information isn't enough to determine when Rengar is strong or weak.
Rengar.teamfight: Position so your backline stays behind the frontline and within vision, then counter Rengar's engage.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Sejuani.fight: If Sejuani's Frost Armor is active, damage her first to create a window when her slow immunity is gone.
Sejuani.laning: Engage when your ally's lane is pushed in and you can keep the opponent within engage range, and check whether Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down.
Sejuani.escape: Right after Sejuani's only mobility tool, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, has been used is your opening to engage. Once the stun from Sejuani E Permafrost has been spent, use the brief window when stacks cannot build again, but create distance to dodge the first auto-attack immediately after the stun.
Sejuani.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways when you see their windups. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before the second strike, which carries most of the damage and the slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from her melee allies’ basic attacks, so immediately create distance as the stacks build.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid staying close and fighting for too long. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so knocking her up cannot interrupt her engage.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Also get armor to withstand the physical damage from her basic attacks. If the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana first when her Fury is empty. When Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available, look for a chance to knock her up after she lands instead of trying to stop her engage.
Shyvana.laning: Engage when your allied wave is pulled back and Shyvana is within combo range. Take early camps and objectives first to deny her opportunities to stack Shyvana P Scalemail.
Shyvana.combo: Don't try to knock Shyvana up during Shyvana R Dragon's Descent; wait for her to land.
Shyvana.escape: Engage when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her Fury is empty. You can also look to counterattack when she returns to human form and loses her bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path and her empowered AoE abilities.

Shaco.watch: Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives; check them first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, keep your back from being exposed by standing with a wall behind you or facing your allies. When low on health, avoid paths without vision so Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison can't hit you. When Shaco R Hallucinate's clone dies, it leaves an explosion and boxes behind, so move away immediately.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get health as well to avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Consider movement speed to help you leave telegraphed danger zones.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive is a chance to close the distance and focus your damage with allies. If Shaco uses Shaco R Hallucinate, don't waste your damage on the clone; identify the real Shaco by watching the health bar's response.
Shaco.laning: Check that Shaco Q Deceive is down before going in, and maintain vision at your jungle entrances early to prepare for Shaco's ganks and invades.
Shaco.escape: Engage right after Shaco appears in a fight with Shaco Q Deceive, since he can't immediately escape with the same ability.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills and maintain vision at your jungle entrances.
Shaco.teamfight: Focus your damage with allies immediately when Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction during its cast, so sidestep it.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Taliyah has no abilities that reduce your resistances or deal true damage, so your magic resistance remains effective.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down, don't dash across it; go around to close the distance.
Taliyah.laning: Engage when your lane is pushed in and you can keep Taliyah within combo range, and first check whether she has used her mobility. If Taliyah disappears from vision, retreat early, accounting for her movement speed near walls and her ability to influence other lanes with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.combo: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down along your engage path, first find a way to go around it.
Taliyah.escape: Look to engage when Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove are down. If you haven't damaged Taliyah yet, she can put up a wall to escape, so carefully plan your angle of pursuit.
Taliyah.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage when charged, so back away or move to the side when you see her charging to dodge it. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and increases Vi's attack speed with consecutive hits, so don't fight her for too long.
Vi.build: Build armor first since the main damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force is physical. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. Consider an option that reduces attack speed too, since Vi's basic attacks and attack speed are central to her damage.
Vi.fight: Fight briefly right after Vi P Blast Shield is removed and Vi Q Vault Breaker has been used. Avoid extended trades because Vi W Denting Blows becomes more effective with consecutive attacks.
Vi.laning: Engage when your lane is pushed in and you can keep the opponent within range of your two abilities, and first check whether Vi Q Vault Breaker is down. If Vi has just landed an ability and activated Vi P Blast Shield, delay the trade until the shield is removed.
Vi.combo: Don't use your knock-up while Vi is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; wait until she has finished landing.
Vi.escape: Take advantage if Vi R Cease and Desist is down, but if Vi R Cease and Desist is in progress, act after she finishes landing.
Vi.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping enemies rather than dealing damage.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain and stuns you if he grabs you and slams you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. You can be pulled over terrain near the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, so keep your distance there in particular.
Skarner.fight: Before engaging, stay outside melee range so you don't keep taking empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Engage when your allied wave is pushed in and you can keep Skarner within EQ range, and check whether Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is on cooldown. During the fight, avoid standing with your back to a wall so Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can't grab and stun you.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner R Impale is available, choose your engage position knowing that you can't escape with a movement ability while suppressed.
Skarner.escape: You can't break Skarner R Impale with a movement ability while suppressed, so don't force an engage when Skarner is close enough to use it.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping rather than damage. If you give Skarner time to complete his tank items, beware of fights where he keeps you locked down.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale; if so, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that focus only on adding health.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns the first target it hits. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid staying in close combat for too long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. However, Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone can't block all his damage. Account for his maximum-health damage and avoid building only a large amount of health. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Udyr.fight: When the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is removed, press the attack and don't give him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, track his path with vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and don't overextend in lane. Gank when your allied wave is pushed in and the enemy is within combo range, and check whether Udyr E Blazing Stampede has been used before engaging.
Udyr.escape: After being stunned once, fight back or escape during the period when Udyr cannot stun the same target again.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping rather than damage. The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage at each stage against Udyr.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't try to burst Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target the weaker enemies behind him.

Warwick.watch: Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses and heals him, and the higher his movement speed, the farther he leaps, so keep a wide distance from areas without vision.
Warwick.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Also prepare for his physical damage from basic attacks. If healing makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Warwick.fight: If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, back off and re-engage after the fear triggers.
Warwick.laning: Approach when your allied wave is pushed in and the enemy is within EQ range, and check whether Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast and R Infinite Duress are on cooldown. Below half health, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position, so when your health is borderline, give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.escape: Don't engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is on cooldown. Wait until Warwick R Infinite Duress has also been used, then look for an opening before R comes back up.
Warwick.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping rather than damage.
Warwick.teamfight: If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits an ally, focus on saving the suppressed ally and concentrate your counterattack while Warwick is locked in place. If your team is engaged on first, use R Cataclysm to cut off the enemy engager's path.

Viego.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and R Heartbreaker. If healing makes the duel drag on, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Viego.fight: Check that Viego W Spectral Maw and R Heartbreaker are both on cooldown before engaging. Don't start skirmishes you can't win, so you don't give Viego a kill.
Viego.laning: When the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path is visible, don't push the lane in that direction. Place a Control Ward or take a route around the area.
Viego.escape: Don't engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is on cooldown.
Viego.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping rather than damage, and don't give Viego a kill that lets him snowball.
Viego.watch: When Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, watch for a camouflaged Viego approaching. When your health is low, back off and beware Viego R Heartbreaker, which deals damage based on your missing health.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If his healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning's thrust sideways, then engage right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard activates, create distance and counterattack once its immunity window ends.
XinZhao.laning: Before engaging, check whether Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down.
XinZhao.combo: While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, wait for its immunity window to end, then counterattack.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and trapping rather than damage, and look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback can split your formation, so avoid standing too close to your allies.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you make Xin Zhao use E Audacious Charge is your window to engage. Once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, close the distance and fight again.

Zac.watch: Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so create distance after absorbing his engage. Step on the chunks Zac leaves behind to stop him from healing.
Zac.build: Complete one core item first, then fit Executioner's Calling in if healing from Zac P Cell Division becomes a problem. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot. Since W damage scales with your maximum health, avoid options that add a large amount of health alone.
Zac.fight: While fighting at close range, step on the chunks to stop Zac from healing.
Zac.laning: Engage when your allied lane is pushed in and the opponent comes within EQ range, and check whether Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. If you see Zac charging E behind a wall, look for an angle to interrupt it with EQ.
Zac.combo: Cast Jarvan IV E Demacian Standard, then immediately use Q Dragon Strike toward the flag to knock Zac up. Immediately after landing, follow up with a basic attack to deal P Martial Cadence damage, trap Zac with R Cataclysm, then add a shield and slow with W Golden Aegis. If Zac's chunks are nearby, move over them to prevent him from healing.
Zac.phase: You are strong through midgame while building your items, so create fights and pressure objectives when Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. In the late game, focus on engaging and trapping rather than damage.
Zac.teamfight: When trapping a backline damage dealer, use R from a position your allies can follow up from immediately. If an allied damage dealer gets trapped with them, break the wall.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below slows and knocks you up and also causes a cooldown reset, so if Bel'Veth closes in, don't run straight back; dodge by turning to the side.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom deal mainly physical damage, so build armor first. If healing is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet deals true damage that resistances cannot block, so you need a high total health pool to withstand it.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways; the window to engage opens right after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down.
Belveth.teamfight: If an ally dies and leaves behind a Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth can pick it up, and delay teamfights while Bel'Veth's transformation is active.
Belveth.laning: Engage when your ally's lane is pushed in and Bel'Veth is within your EQ range, and first check whether Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down. In early skirmishes, steal camps and large monsters before Bel'Veth can build stacks to delay her growth from the start.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can quickly run along the trail it leaves, so don't flee in a straight line; turn toward an ally or turret. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, so don't immediately use your key crowd control when the shield is active.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first to defend against Nocturne's main damage. Keep in mind that armor cannot block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the fear rather than staying close and fighting back.
Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances to prepare for Nocturne R Paranoia, and decide where you'll retreat before the darkness falls.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, stay close to your allies so you aren't isolated. When engaging first, trap an enemy backline damage dealer from a position your allies can follow up from immediately.
